articles.title: Elena Rybakina out before the WTA Finals begin, and Marta Kostyuk steps in

articles.title: No. 3 Utah snaps three-game losing streak to No. 7 BYU with 28-20 win over Cougars

articles.title: Stamkos has goal, assist to lead Predators to 3-1 victory over Blues

articles.title: Jahiem Lawson returns fumble 22 yards for a score, Clemson holds on to defeat Syracuse 18-13
articles.dek: Jahiem Lawson returned Syracuse quarterback Steve Angeli's fumble 22 yards for a score, Ashton Hampton intercepted Angeli in the end zone and Clemson held on to defeat the Orange 18-13 Saturday.

articles.title: No. 10 Texas scores three unanswered TDs in the second half to rally past No. 19 Missouri, 34-20

articles.title: Baylor Hayes to Oran Singleton Jr. connection lights it up for Tulsa in 60-10 rout of Tulane

articles.title: Weaver passes, runs for TDs and Monmouth clinches at least share of CAA title with 7th straight win

articles.title: Three Billy Edwards TD passes lift UNC to 38-21 win over UConn in Belichick's return to New England

articles.title: Cooper's penalty gives the Current a 1-0 extra time quarterfinal win over Angel City

articles.title: Yoder rushes for 181 yards, 2 TDs as Lehigh beats Colgate 33-7 to keep sole possession of 1st
